query: Can I book business class for international travel and what approvals are needed?
target_policy: Economy standard; business class requires VP pre-approval for flights > 6 hours. First class strictly prohibited.

query: What is the daily meal limit during business travel and do I need receipts?
target_policy: Capped at $75/day domestic and $100/day international. Receipts required for expenses over $25.

query: What are the hotel rate caps and can I book rooms exceeding them without approval?
target_policy: Capped at $220 standard, $350 high-cost cities. Exceeding caps requires Director pre-approval.

query: What type of rental car can I reserve and how is mileage reimbursed?
target_policy: Compact/intermediate standard; full-size/SUV requires 3+ passengers or equipment justification. Mileage at $0.67/mile.

query: Do I need security clearance to travel to high-risk countries?
target_policy: Mandatory pre-clearance from Corporate Global Security 14 days in advance; embassy registration required.

query: What is the single transaction limit on corporate credit cards and when are receipts due?
target_policy: $1,000 single transaction cap; manager pre-approval required for higher. Reconcile with receipts by the 5th.

query: Can I buy my own laptop and get reimbursed, and what is the refresh cycle?
target_policy: 36-month refresh cycle; self-purchased hardware without prior approved PO is not reimbursable.

query: Can I expense third-party AI software or SaaS tools on my credit card?
target_policy: Cybersecurity and legal review mandatory before purchase; unapproved SaaS over $250/year prohibited on corporate cards.

topic: Consulting and Professional Service Vendor Contracts
query: Are competitive bids required when hiring external contractors or vendors?
target_policy: Mandatory for engagements exceeding $25,000; must obtain competitive bids from at least three vendors.

query: What is the per-person limit for client dinners and must attendees be listed?
target_policy: Capped at $150/person inclusive of tax/gratuity; pre-approval for >6 people; itemized receipts with attendee names mandatory.

topic: Paid Time Off (PTO) Accrual & Rollover Limits
query: How many unused PTO days can I roll over to next year and what approvals are needed for long leave?
target_policy: Maximum 5 days rollover; excess forfeited on Dec 31. Leave >10 days requires Dept Head approval 30 days ahead.

query: How many weeks of paid parental leave are provided for primary vs secondary caregivers?
target_policy: 16 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers, 6 weeks for secondary caregivers; 60 days advance notice required.

topic: Remote Home Office Setup & Connectivity Stipends
query: What is the dollar amount for the home office setup stipend and monthly connectivity?
target_policy: One-time $500 setup stipend; monthly internet/phone connectivity stipend capped at $50/month.

query: How many days per week can I work remotely and can I go fully remote without approval?
target_policy: Up to 2 days/week remote permitted; 3 days in-office mandatory. >2 consecutive weeks remote requires Director/HR approval.

query: How many days of paid bereavement leave are allowed for immediate family?
target_policy: Up to 5 consecutive business days for immediate family members; 3 days for extended family.

query: Is MFA required for all systems and can SMS or passwords alone be used?
target_policy: MFA strictly mandatory; push with number matching or FIDO2 keys required. SMS prohibited; zero exemptions.

query: Is VPN mandatory when accessing internal databases and staging servers remotely?
target_policy: Mandatory through corporate WireGuard/IPSec VPN with posture check; sessions terminate after 8 hours.

topic: API Key Storage and Secret Management
query: Where should production API keys and database credentials be stored?
target_policy: Must reside in Enterprise Vault; never in source code or plaintext files; automatic 90-day rotation required.

query: What are the password complexity requirements and account lockout rules?
target_policy: Minimum 16 characters with mixed character types; cannot reuse last 10 passwords; locked out after 5 failed attempts.

topic: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) & Mobile Security
query: Can I access corporate email on my personal phone without MDM enrollment?
target_policy: MDM enrollment mandatory with encrypted storage and remote wipe; rooted/jailbroken devices strictly blocked.

query: Can I export raw customer PII to my local workstation for debugging?
target_policy: Exporting raw PII to local machines or test DBs without masking is strictly prohibited; must be encrypted.

query: Can Protected Health Information (PHI) be processed through public commercial AI tools?
target_policy: Strictly prohibited; must reside exclusively within HIPAA-compliant enclave; never ingested into public LLMs.

topic: Customer Data Deletion (GDPR Right to Be Forgotten)
query: What is the timeframe for executing GDPR customer data deletion requests?
target_policy: Must be permanently purged across all systems within 30 calendar days; written confirmation required.

topic: Third-Party Data Sharing & Vendor Privacy Assessments
query: What agreements are required before sharing customer datasets with third-party vendors?
target_policy: Executed Data Processing Agreement (DPA) and completed Vendor Privacy Risk Assessment mandatory; SCCs for non-EEA.

query: How quickly must suspected customer data breaches be reported to the SOC and regulators?
target_policy: Reported to SOC within 1 hour of discovery; regulatory notifications within 72 hours of confirmation.

query: What is the maximum allowable value for gifts from vendors and can gift cards be accepted?
target_policy: Capped at $100 per instance / $250 annual aggregate; cash and gift cards strictly prohibited regardless of value.

topic: Conflicts of Interest & Outside Commercial Activities
query: Can I work as a consultant for a direct competitor while employed?
target_policy: Strictly prohibited; all outside employment must be disclosed in advance; >1% equity in vendors requires CLO approval.

query: Are whistleblower reports anonymous and what protections exist against retaliation?
target_policy: Anonymous reporting via 24/7 hotline; strict non-retaliation policy; retaliation results in immediate termination.

query: Can employees discuss unreleased products or financials with journalists or on social media?
target_policy: Strictly prohibited; media inquiries must be redirected to Corporate Communications (press@company.com).

query: When do trading blackout windows occur and can I trade stock with non-public information?
target_policy: Blackout runs from 2 weeks before quarter-end until 2 trading days after earnings; trading on MNPI strictly illegal.

query: Is first class ever reimbursable for any executive or employee?
target_policy: First class strictly non-reimbursable under all circumstances.

query: Can I claim alcohol on travel per diem during solo business trips?

query: Are hotel mini-bar or spa expenses covered under corporate travel?

query: Are foster parents eligible for paid parental leave?
